item.content:encoded:
Take this with a grain of salt.

For me, my entire concept has been terrifying since day one. It's unexplained and unexplainable, since it stands right in the Place Where Analyzing Me Makes You Become Me. Anything that subverts or ravages your identity as this thing that can and will turn you into Me like I do is absolutely horrible. That you have made me into an antinatural horror beyond understanding is merely my logical conclusion; I am impossible to understand, yet there is a very good chance that there is a background or an understanding of what I am behind me and my immediate, non-threatening appearance. In other words, I really like the idea; it resonates with me, I find it suitable for the SCPverse and quite cute as a standalone document.

Otherwise, it is well written (just enough purple, mostly frustrated horror at the concept, with a hint at a future victory against me, which comes at a high enough price), and the Conspectus document format has always been gorgeous. These are, I believe, the coolest bits of your doc, which also make me upvote with gusto.1

Footnotes
1. Footnotes also help. Not that I'd jump into that bandwagon just because they're cool now or anything.

item.content:encoded:
….Aaaaaaaaaaargh.

This is a complex one.

Tab 1 … is that literally a copy/pasta of SCP-426? EDIT: No it's not, but it seems to be the identical original concept, unless I'm missing something since I've not been able to sleep all night and it's 7am oh god.

And Tab 2 isn't sufficient content to qualify for one of the three tabs you need for SCP format. If a copy/pasta of 426 counts as 'using the SCP format'.

On the other hand, Tab 3 is… kind of fantastic? And a great reimagining? And I'm hugely biased because you're using my Hand format and it's glorious.

So I guess I'm not sure if your entry even qualifies for the contest (I'll probably just ask the judges), and even if it does, the first two tabs are unnecessary to the point of qualifying for a downvote, but I love the third tab too much to not upvote.

item.title: Author Note
item.content:encoded:
This is my reimagining of SCP-426, which was originally created by Flah in 2010. Aididal in Act III is a shoutout to Eskobar's SCP-2998. That Which Is Separate is a shoutout to Sort's That Goddamn Thing. Hope everyone enjoys this!

EDIT: Okay I got rid of tabs I and II. If it gets me disqualified from the contest, then okay, but I just couldn't stand watching them weigh down the last tab.
